summary: Pass: both round-2 problems are fixed. The switch close-up (47–51 s) is now navy line art that fits the frame, and the closing beat (63–68 s) shows a full-width six-step bar that shrinks into a green 0.2秒 over an uncropped reader. The hook works from second 0: the card taps, a green flash, then 電池なし on the word. The rest of the reel is clean, in sync and on palette. Small nits remain but do not block posting: the closing reader is small and its flap barely reads, and 1356万回『向きを変える』 simplifies a 13.56 MHz cycle.
